assets.name: Jumping jacks
assets.cue: Land softly; keep your ribs stacked over your hips.

assets.name: Bodyweight squat
assets.cue: Press through the whole foot; let your knees track over your toes.

assets.name: Push-up
assets.cue: Keep your body in one long line from shoulders to heels.

assets.name: Reverse lunge
assets.cue: Step back quietly; keep your front knee comfortably aligned.

assets.name: Mountain climber
assets.cue: Brace your core and keep your shoulders over your hands.

assets.name: Glute bridge
assets.cue: Lift from your hips; keep your ribs relaxed and feet grounded.

assets.name: Crunch
assets.cue: Curl your shoulders up; avoid pulling on your neck.

assets.name: Calf raise
assets.cue: Rise through the balls of your feet; lower with control.
